title: Counter Input
text: 从一个或多个计数器输入通道读取；输出 2 路；按 {Reset after read} 指定计数器复位策略；{Install new board} 指定注册板卡 < no board、{Delete current board} 指定删除当前板卡、{Board setup} 指定板卡、{Sample time} 指定模块的采样时间、{Maximum missed ticks} 指定模型可以落后内核的定时器节拍数、{Show “Missed Ticks” port} 指定将错过的节拍数发送到 Missed Ticks 端口、{Yield CPU when waiting} 指定内核等待硬件时让出 CPU、{Input channels} 指定计数器输入通道、{Clock input source} 指定使计数器递增的时钟输入 input pin rising、{Gate input functionality} 指定计数器门控输入引脚的操作、{Output data type} 指定模块输出的数据类型，按实例取值。

ports.name: Counter Data
ports.summary: 从输入通道读取的计数器数据 vector

ports.name: Missed Ticks
ports.summary: 错过的节拍计数（可选） double

params.name: Install new board
params.values: 注册板卡 < no board selected > (default)

params.name: Maximum missed ticks
params.values: 模型可以落后内核的定时器节拍数 10 (default) | integer

params.name: Show “Missed Ticks” port
params.values: 将错过的节拍数发送到 Missed Ticks 端口 ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Yield CPU when waiting
params.values: 内核等待硬件时让出 CPU ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Input channels
params.values: 选择计数器输入通道 1 (default) | vector

params.name: Reset after read
params.values: 计数器复位策略 never (default) | always | level | rising edge | falling edge | either edge

params.name: Clock input source
params.values: 使计数器递增的时钟输入 input pin rising edge (default) | input pin falling edge | internal clock

params.name: Gate input functionality
params.values: 计数器门控输入引脚的操作 none (default) | enable when high | enable when low | start on rising edge | start on falling edge | reset on rising edge | reset on falling edge | latch on rising edge | latch on falling edge | latch & reset on rising edge | latch & reset on falling edge | enable when high, latch & reset on edge | enable when low, latch & reset on edge

params.name: Output data type
params.values: 模块输出的数据类型 double (default) | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32
